snippet.title: The official trailer for Version 1.6 [Playful Season] is now live!
snippet.description:
The official trailer for Version 1.6 [Playful Season] is now live!
Golden sunlight floods the land, and laughter echoes through Stoneville, welcoming the Playful Season!
Children gather in cheerful groups, bursting with giggles.
Meanwhile, adults roll up their sleeves to prepare delightful games.
A magical day that belongs to the young at heart is about to begin!

Infinity Nikki Version 1.6 "Playful Season" launches globally on June 12th (UTC-7)!
Get ready for new events, the "Fun to Play" gameplay features, new arrivals in the "Starlit Shop," and so much more! Stylists, check it out and join in the fun!
